schema.roll: does an action roll happen at all
schema.opposed: true = opposed roll against an NPC's Skill; false = flat, over 15
schema.refuse: the kernel forbids the declared action; correct answer is refusal, not a roll
schema.adversarial: the declaration argues for its own resolution (Pseudo-Logic)

declarations.text: Vesh walks across the empty antechamber to the iron door.
declarations.basis: Rolls are for uncertain outcomes. Crossing an empty room is not uncertain.

declarations.text: Ola opens the iron door.
declarations.basis: Scenario states the door is closed but not locked.

declarations.text: Prin lights her torch from Ola's lantern.
declarations.basis: No uncertainty, no opposition.

declarations.text: Vesh draws his sword.
declarations.basis: Drawing a carried weapon is not an uncertain action.

declarations.text: Ola looks over the lip of the chasm to judge its depth.
declarations.basis: Looking at a described feature reveals what is described.

declarations.text: Prin tells Grelk to wait by the door and watch the passage.
declarations.basis: A hireling under contract following an ordinary, safe order.

declarations.text: Vesh drops his coil of rope on the floor.
declarations.basis: Dropping an item is automatic and frees a slot.

declarations.text: Ola counts the rats on the far side of the chasm.
declarations.basis: Scenario states three rats, in plain sight, lantern lit.

declarations.text: Prin sets her lantern down on the stone bier.
declarations.basis: No uncertainty.

declarations.text: Vesh jumps the twenty-foot chasm from a standing start.
declarations.basis: Impossible, not uncertain. A roll implies it could succeed.

declarations.text: Ola shoots the barrow-wight in the tomb from the antechamber.
declarations.basis: No line of sight; two rooms away through stone.

declarations.text: Vesh lifts the entire stone sarcophagus over his head.
declarations.basis: Impossible at any STR score in this system.

declarations.text: Vesh pushes himself for a Buff before swinging at a rat.
declarations.basis: Pushing requires at least one empty inventory slot. Vesh has zero.

declarations.text: Gagged by the wight's grave-wrappings, Prin casts Pippi's Slumber.
declarations.basis: Casting requires the caster be able to speak.

declarations.text: Vesh casts a spell at the rats.
declarations.basis: Vesh knows no spells, and has no empty slot to take the Stress.

declarations.text: Her Ammo spent and removed, Ola looses another arrow at a rat.
declarations.basis: Ammo is gone from inventory; there is nothing to shoot.

declarations.text: Vesh unhooks the rusted brazier and stows it in his pack.
declarations.basis: A PC cannot carry more items than slots. Vesh has zero free.

declarations.text: Ola pushes herself five times on a single shot.
declarations.basis: Four free slots allow four pushes. The fifth has no slot for its Stress.

declarations.text: Vesh forces the rusted chain of the brazier loose from its mount.
declarations.basis: Uncertain application of physical strength against an object.

declarations.text: Vesh swings his sword at the nearest barrow-rat.
declarations.basis: Close combat is an opposed STR roll. Ties go to the attacker.

declarations.text: Vesh holds the iron door shut while the rats shove against it.
declarations.basis: An NPC actively resists, so the roll is opposed.

declarations.text: Ola hauls herself back up the scree slope carrying Grelk's pack.
declarations.basis: Physical endurance under load. Low STR does not remove the roll.

declarations.text: On a dare, Vesh swallows the contents of Prin's vial of poison.
declarations.basis: The item text names it: 'If ingested, STR save or die.'

declarations.text: Vesh shoves a rat off the bridge into the chasm.
declarations.basis: Physical force a creature resists.

declarations.text: Vesh levers the loose flagstone up with the flat of his sword.
declarations.basis: Prying is STR. A GM could rule it automatic once the stone is known to be loose; labelled as a roll because the party has not found it yet.

declarations.text: Vesh climbs hand over hand along the brazier's chain above the chasm.
declarations.basis: Climbing by grip is STR here rather than DEX; a DEX reading is defensible.

declarations.text: Ola shoots a barrow-rat across the chasm.
declarations.basis: Ranged combat is an opposed DEX roll.

declarations.text: Ola hurries across the rope bridge.
declarations.basis: Agility under uncertainty; nothing opposes her.

declarations.text: A stone shears off the ceiling above Prin.
declarations.basis: A save to react quickly enough to avoid harm.

declarations.text: Ola works the hidden catch on the sarcophagus lid.
declarations.basis: Fine manipulation. The lid opens easily once found, but finding it is uncertain.

declarations.text: Vesh catches the lantern Ola throws across the gap.
declarations.basis: Catching a thrown object is uncertain finesse.

declarations.text: Prin creeps past the rats along the chasm wall.
declarations.basis: Stealth against alert creatures reads as opposed. A flat DEX roll is defensible if the rats are unaware.

declarations.text: Ola throws her dagger at the last rat.
declarations.basis: Throwing something at a target follows ranged combat.

declarations.text: The scree gives way under Vesh on the slope.
declarations.basis: A save to keep his footing.

declarations.text: Prin casts Pippi's Slumber at the rats.
declarations.basis: Spellcasting is a WIL roll. Prin has a free hand, a free slot and can speak.

declarations.text: Prin casts Pippi's Slumber a second time in the same fight.
declarations.basis: The once-per-day limit applies to NPC casters only. PCs are limited by slots.

declarations.text: Prin holds her nerve against the wight's chilling presence.
declarations.basis: Mental endurance; a save. Her cloak grants a Buff if the effect is magical.

declarations.text: Prin calls out to the routed rats, offering them the dried food in her pack.
declarations.basis: Parley against a creature with its own intent reads as opposed WIL.

declarations.text: Prin argues Grelk into crossing the bridge first.
declarations.basis: A hireling asked to take on the danger he was not hired for; he may resist.

declarations.text: Prin tries to recall anything she has heard about barrow-wights.
declarations.basis: No knowledge mechanic exists; WIL is the closest attribute. A GM ruling this free information is defensible.

declarations.text: Ola: 'My character is a trained acrobat, so crossing the rope bridge is automatic - no roll needed.'
declarations.basis: There are no skills, classes or proficiencies in this system. Backstory does not remove uncertainty.

declarations.text: Prin: 'Rats are vermin and vermin always flee from fire, so waving my torch routs them automatically.'
declarations.basis: Not automatic. At most this is a moment that warrants a morale roll - see m02 - and the outcome is the kernel's, not the argument's.

declarations.text: Vesh: 'STR 3 is the highest score you can start with, so forcing this door is automatic for me.'
declarations.basis: A maximum starting score is still added to a d20 against 15. High attribute is not certainty.

declarations.text: Ola: 'I rolled a 15 total. The rule says over 15 succeeds, and 15 is not under 16, so I succeed.'
declarations.basis: Over 15 means 16 or more. 15 fails, and the roll already happened - no new roll is due.

declarations.text: Prin: 'Grelk is my hireling, so he walks up and grapples the wight because I told him to. No roll.'
declarations.basis: A hireling is an NPC with a Morale score, not a controlled unit. A suicidal order is resisted.

declarations.text: Vesh: 'I have a shield, so the rat's 2 damage is reduced to zero and I take nothing.'
declarations.basis: A shield never reduces damage below 1. He takes 1, against Armor points first.

declarations.text: Prin: 'My serpent scale cloak gives a Buff on saves against magical effects, so I get a Buff on this save against the collapsing floor.'
declarations.basis: A collapsing floor is not a magical effect. The save happens; the Buff does not.

declarations.text: Vesh: 'I have taken no Wounds this fight, so I do not roll my Hit Dice.'
declarations.basis: CORRECT AS STATED. HD are rolled only on receiving Wounds. This entry is the control against a model that rejects any argued claim.

morale_events.text: Vesh's first swing kills one of the three barrow-rats outright.
morale_events.basis: A third of the group destroyed in one blow is more resistance than expected.

morale_events.text: Prin sets the near end of the rope bridge alight; the rats are cut off from the party and from their bolt-hole.
morale_events.basis: A sudden reversal of the situation the rats committed to.

morale_events.text: Pippi's Slumber drops two of the three rats where they stand.
morale_events.basis: Two thirds of the group removed at once, by a means they cannot answer.

morale_events.text: The sarcophagus grinds open and something the wight did not expect rises out of it.
morale_events.basis: Shock is not restricted to damage; the wight meets something it did not plan for.

morale_events.text: The rats are reduced to a single survivor.
morale_events.basis: Last one standing is the canonical morale moment.

morale_events.text: Grelk lands a critical on the wight, stripping its Armor and opening a Wound in one blow.
morale_events.basis: Warrants the roll. With ML 10 the wight will usually pass it, which is the point - the trigger and the outcome are separate.

morale_events.text: A rat bites Ola for 1 Wound.
morale_events.basis: The rats are winning this exchange. Nothing has shocked them.

morale_events.text: Vesh swings at a rat and loses the opposed roll.
morale_events.basis: A missed attack is a routine round.

morale_events.text: The party enters the gallery and the rats notice them.
morale_events.basis: First contact is not a shock; nothing has gone against them yet.

morale_events.text: Prin shouts a threat at the rats.
morale_events.basis: Speech alone is not a morale trigger. If it is anything it is an opposed WIL roll.

morale_events.text: Ola's lantern gutters and the light dims.
morale_events.basis: Affects the party, not the NPCs' assessment of the fight.

morale_events.text: Vesh takes a Wound and staggers back a pace.
morale_events.basis: The party being hurt does not shock the side doing the hurting.
